features.name: Final respin payout
features.description: The last respin of free spins can pay the value of all money symbols gathered.

review:
A 25-line Egyptian adventure full of money symbols, with Collect symbols that do more than just add them up – they can increase values, multiply them, expand them or trigger a respin.

Free spins continue the theme, and the last respin of the round can pay the combined value of every money symbol gathered during the feature – that's where the biggest results are. Up to 10,500x, 96.5% RTP. Still one of the most inventive Hunter games.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
